aborted_attempts.error: Error: executor_v2 step 10: ToolCallFailed (HTTP 502): The app's API call failed: GET /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets failed before a response arrived. Recovery: Read the reported error and check the corresponding request or configuration. Retryable (unchanged call): no.
aborted_attempts.note: Slim publish board rep3 aborted mid-executor_v2 under the prior fail-fast harness. Session progress logged ok through 7000/10000; the next session threw ToolCallFailed (HTTP 502) on step 10 (r2-list-buckets) and exited the process — no board-rep3 artifact was written. That is an Executor under-load result, not only a harness glitch. Rep3 was restarted with continue-on-error so further 502s count toward error_rate.
aborted_attempts.proportion_note: One hard failure after ≥7000 ok sessions is an error rate on the order of ~0.01% for that incomplete arm (lower bound: ≥1/10000 if the arm had finished). Keep in proportion: possible Executor beta bug, resource limit under sustained load, or harness/mock interaction. Board error columns show it for every arm; do not amplify into a headline. Private repro to Executor maintainers is welcome if repeatable.

interpretation.rep1_rep2: All arms finished with task_success_rate=1.0 under fail-fast (any failure would have aborted the arm). Recorded error_rate=0 for completed arms.
interpretation.rep3_aborted: executor_v2 returned HTTP 502 on r2-list-buckets after ≥7000 successful sessions (~0.01% order). Incomplete arm under fail-fast; rep3 restarted with continue-on-error + all-attempted-session token/latency accounting (partial steps kept).
interpretation.rep3_completed: Rep3 completed under continue-on-error with metrics_policy=all_attempted_sessions_primary. All arms error_rate=0 including executor_v2 (cleared the prior ≥7000 abort point). Prior aborted attempt remains in aborted_attempts for the record.

metrics_policy.task_success: Failed sessions count against task_success_rate; success_rate + error_rate = 1.
metrics_policy.tokens_latency_primary: Means include every attempted session; failed sessions keep tokens/latency up to the failing step.

summary_run_notes.rep3_restart: Rep 3 was restarted after executor_v2 ToolCallFailed (HTTP 502) on step 10 (r2-list-buckets) aborted the first slim-board attempt around session 7000+ under the old fail-fast harness. See board-error-inventory.json. Restart uses continue-on-error so session failures increment error_rate instead of exiting. A later restart attempt failed harness-side (wrong EXECUTOR_BIN without `apps`); this run uses /tmp/executor-v2 CLI.

rep3_error_policy.note: Continue-on-error: failed sessions counted in error_rate / errors_by_kind.
